rule: Every article assigned to these five sections must be specifically about Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Material whose primary subject is another individual, a generic religious theme, another prophet, a companion, a family member, a historical school, or a source study must not remain in a Prophet-only section unless the article is explicitly centered on Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
futurePublishingRequirement: New records targeting a Prophet-only section should declare subjectScope=prophet-muhammad. Records without an explicit scope are checked against direct Prophet-Muhammad markers and reclassified if the check fails.
